regime_context: China A-shares show an extremely narrow one-narrative tape: only Coal and Banks are trend-eligible, with Coal as a lone dominant theme (one_narrative=true, breadth 0.6) over a mean-reverting benchmark. The detector's one validated edge (absolute-trend gate) did NOT hold on this market's history (gate_helps=false), and track-record directional accuracy is poor (0.348), so all leans are low-conviction judgement, not edge extraction.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Coal's leadership begins to erode toward Banks: specifically, if in the next ~10 sessions Banks overtakes Coal in the rotation margin while Coal breadth (currently 0.6) degrades below 0.5, that would retire the lone-narrative-watch and suggest a handoff is confirmed, not predicted.

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the only scorable eligible theme, is the rotation leader (margin 0.212 over Banks), and shows moderate but positive breadth (0.6) with no crowding flag (z=0.72). This is a focus/attention lean on the prevailing leadership, not a return forecast — the theme is eligible on the trend gate but the gate itself has no validated edge here (gate_helps=false).
theses.dissent: hurt_tag is mean-revert and the trend gate failed historically on this market (gate_helps=false) — coal's leadership may be a late-stage crowding of a mean-reverting resource tape that whipsaws, and a near-sole eligible theme often marks a stretched, narrow top.

falsifier.text: 515220.SS (Coal ETF) underperforms CSI 300 by 5% or more before the 20-day check-by date.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks is the only other eligible theme and the rotation challenger, but it is crowded (z=1.81, crowded=true) with perfect breadth (1.0) — a size-down caution. The lean is a modest underweight relative to the leader, not a fade or absolute bear call.
theses.dissent: durability_bar 0.84 and breadth 1.0 are the strongest trend-health readings in the entire rank list — broad, persistent participation can mean the crowded status is a continuation, not a top, and Banks may simply grind through.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS (Banks ETF) leads CSI 300 by 5% or more before the 20-day check-by date.

theses.subject: Solar / Photovoltaics
theses.thesis: Solar has the most negative crowd positioning of all scored tiers (z=-2.28) and deeply negative rank score (-0.603), with negligible breadth (0.067). This is an avoid on trend-health and liquidity, not a structural short.
theses.dissent: Extreme under-crowding (z=-2.28) can be a reflexivity setup if a policy or demand shock hits — the least-owned theme has the most room to rip, and Solar has historically been a high-beta mean-revert candidate on China tape.

falsifier.text: 515790.SS (Solar ETF) rallies more than 10% relative to CSI 300 before the 20-day check-by date.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
